_meta.source: data/labels.json (DailyMed SPL; OVCA records fetched 2026-10-05, new records 2026-10-06)
_meta.use: Applied to every regimen that contains the drug, in addition to the regimen's own trial-specific risk_rules.

effects.exclude: label §4 contraindication, or a label instruction not to start
effects.caution: a label stop/hold rule the patient's baseline is already close to

carboplatin.reason: Label: do not repeat until neutrophils ≥2,000 and platelets ≥100,000
Label: CrCl <15 mL/min — data too limited for a dose recommendation

cisplatin.reason: Label: withhold until platelets ≥100,000 and WBC ≥4,000
Label §2.5: consider permanent discontinuation for grade 3–4 neuropathy; baseline G2 leaves little margin
Label: impaired creatinine clearance → consider alternative treatment

paclitaxel.reason: Label: do not treat solid tumours with baseline neutrophils <1,500/mm³
Label Table 17: transaminases ≥10×ULN or bilirubin >5×ULN → not recommended

doxorubicin.reason: Label §4: severe myocardial insufficiency or MI within 4–6 weeks; §2.3 cardiomyopathy → discontinue
Label §4: severe hepatic impairment (Child-Pugh C or bilirubin >5 mg/dL)
Label Table 1: dose reduced by bilirubin (1.2–3 and 3.1–5 mg/dL)

topotecan.reason: Label: first cycle only if neutrophils ≥1,500 and platelets ≥100,000

ifosfamide.reason: IFEX §2.2: repeat only after recovery from haematologic toxicity

bevacizumab.reason: AVASTIN §2: start ≥28 days after major surgery and when the wound is healed
AVASTIN §2: proteinuria ≥2 g/24 h → withhold; hypertensive crisis → discontinue

olaparib.reason: Label 5.1: do not start until haematologic toxicity from prior chemotherapy has recovered to ≤G1
Label 2.5: CrCl 31–50 → 200 mg BID; <31 not studied

niraparib.reason: Label 5.2: do not start until recovered to ≤G1

pembrolizumab.reason: Checkpoint-inhibitor trials excluded active autoimmune disease; the label has no contraindication
KEYTRUDA §2.3: permanent discontinuation if prednisone cannot be reduced to ≤10 mg/day within 12 weeks

dostarlimab.reason: JEMPERLI §2: pneumonitis G3–4 or recurrent G2 → permanent discontinuation
Checkpoint-inhibitor trials excluded active autoimmune disease; JEMPERLI §4 lists no contraindication

atezolizumab.reason: Checkpoint-inhibitor trials excluded active autoimmune disease; TECENTRIQ §4 lists no contraindication
TECENTRIQ §2: myocarditis or pericarditis G2–4 → permanent discontinuation

durvalumab.reason: Checkpoint-inhibitor trials excluded active autoimmune disease; the label has no contraindication

nivolumab.reason: OPDIVO/YERVOY §2.3: pneumonitis G3–4 → permanent discontinuation of both drugs
Checkpoint-inhibitor trials excluded active autoimmune disease
Combination label: AST/ALT >5×ULN → permanent discontinuation of both
Label: permanent discontinuation if prednisone cannot be reduced to ≤10 mg/day within 12 weeks

lenvatinib.reason: LENVIMA §2.7: cardiac dysfunction G4 and arterial thromboembolism of any grade → permanent discontinuation
LENVIMA §2.7: GI perforation any grade / fistula G3–4 → permanent discontinuation
LENVIMA §2.9: reduced starting dose in severe hepatic impairment; hepatic failure → permanent discontinuation
LENVIMA §2.7: G4 hypertension → permanent discontinuation; proteinuria ≥2 g/24 h → withhold

trastuzumab.reason: HERCEPTIN §2.5: withhold for LVEF decline; permanent discontinuation for persistent decline

trastuzumab_deruxtecan.reason: Label Table 3: LVEF <40% or symptomatic CHF → permanent discontinuation
Label Table 3: any symptomatic (≥G2) ILD → permanent discontinuation

everolimus.reason: AFINITOR §2: non-infectious pneumonitis G2–3 → withhold and reduce; G4 → permanent discontinuation

selinexor.reason: XPOVIO §2: ocular toxicity ≥G3 (excluding cataract) → permanent discontinuation
XPOVIO §2: severe hepatic impairment → reduced starting dose (Table 5)

medroxyprogesterone_acetate.reason: PROVERA §4: active DVT or PE, or a history of these conditions
PROVERA §4: known liver impairment or disease

tamoxifen.reason: Tamoxifen §4: history of DVT/PE is a contraindication for the risk-reduction and DCIS indications only

sacituzumab_govitecan.reason: TRODELVY §2: neutropenia G3–4 or febrile neutropenia → withhold

pazopanib.reason: VOTRIENT §2: ILD/pneumonitis of any grade → permanent discontinuation
VOTRIENT §2: GI perforation of any grade → permanent discontinuation
VOTRIENT §2: hypertensive crisis → permanent discontinuation; proteinuria ≥3 g/24 h → withhold
VOTRIENT §2: LV systolic dysfunction G4 → permanent discontinuation
VOTRIENT §2: ALT >3×ULN with bilirubin >2×ULN → permanent discontinuation

dasatinib.reason: SPRYCEL §2 myelosuppression steps (CML label; no solid-tumour schedule)
